task.description: WF-03 Step 07 DOC-UPDATER for ISS-0170 / GH #497: record the fix in CHANGELOG.md, verify requirement mapping, and close out the issue record with resolution and prevention text.
acceptance_criteria: CHANGELOG.md documents the fix and references GH #497
CHANGELOG.md notes the relationship to ISS-0171 / GH #498 (the opposite defect)
Requirement mapping checked rather than assumed; status updated via reqctl if any maps
docs/issues/ISS-0170.json set to RESOLVED with resolution + prevention text
All four ISS-0170 acceptance criteria confirmed met, with per-criterion evidence

result.summary: CHANGELOG.md gained an ISS-0170 entry under [Unreleased] Fixed, referencing GH #497, covering the symptom (outage renders as a red X identical to a failed test; 40-run breakdown 31/6/3 with only 3 genuine defects), the root cause (no mechanical source of platform-state truth; attribution was an unwritten habit), the three changes (enriched annotation naming incident start time/impact/shortlink, new --summary mode writing to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY, diagnostic duplicated at the head of the build job), and the original misdiagnosis as runner starvation. The relationship to ISS-0171/#498 is stated explicitly as a mirror image: that defect HID real failures via continue-on-error while this one made platform noise look like a defect, so the fix for one must not become the other -- the outage signal may annotate a failure and may never suppress one. The no-masking proof is recorded: 15 gating steps at continue-on-error=None, the sole || true guarding a step that runs no build/test/lint. REQUIREMENT MAPPING: checked, none maps. Searched docs/requirements.yaml (350 requirements) for CI/infrastructure/pipeline/build terms; the only textual hit was an unrelated DB-outage acceptance line. The two nearest candidates were read in full and rejected: WASM-05 is byte-identical .wasm compilation output, ADP-06 is pipeline_run_id on BPM audit records -- both product-domain, neither about the GitHub Actions CI harness. No reqctl set-status or render-status was run, correctly. ISS-0170.json set to RESOLVED with resolved_at, resolved_in_commit f097bf3, resolution and prevention text, and a new acceptance_criteria_evidence array giving per-criterion proof. All four criteria are MET: (1) components API queried for the ungrouped Actions component, running as pre-flight in both the platform_status job and the head of the build job, verified live at exit 0; (2) ::warning:: annotation names the incident plus start time, impact and shortlink, with --summary writing a durable step-summary section, proven by an injected major_outage payload naming the 15:22:49Z start; (3) diagnostic only -- main() returns 0 on every path including the exercised degraded path, and the programmatic audit shows all 15 gating steps unmasked; (4) CLAUDE.md marks the status query MANDATORY with a fourth outcome row for the unchecked case and states that an open incident never converts a genuine failure into an acceptable one.
